title: ALMA High-Level Data Products: submillimetre counterparts of SDSS quasars in the ALMA footprint
question: To create a catalogue of submillimetre continuum counterparts of SDSS Data Release 14 quasars located within the aggregate ALMA footprint observed since Cycle 0 as part of the European ALMA Regional Centre High-Level Data Products initiative.

recipe.goal: Select parent sample of SDSS DR14Q quasars observable by ALMA and match against the ALMA Science Archive footprint
recipe.method: Filter SDSS DR14Q quasars to declination <= 40 deg and query the ALMA TAP service (ivoa.obscore) for target observations intersecting a circle of radius 0.0084 deg in selected extragalactic scientific categories
key_parameters: TAP search radius = 0.0084 deg; scan_intent like '%TARGET%'

recipe.goal: Automatically extract submm continuum sources from ALMA archival images
recipe.method: Run ADMIT task Sfind2D_AT (based on CASA findsources) on full continuum images to detect peaks above 3.5 sigma on primary-beam uncorrected images and fit 2D Gaussians on primary-beam corrected images
assumptions: Point-like or compact source morphology describable by a 2D Gaussian

recipe.goal: Cross-match extracted ALMA sources with SDSS DR14Q quasars and visually inspect candidates
recipe.method: Cross-match ADMIT source list with reduced DR14Q catalogue within a 5 arcsec radius of SDSS coordinates, then visually inspect all candidate images in CARTA to remove artefacts, edge noise, and unassociated nearby sources, and deduplicate multiple extractions on the same source
key_parameters: Visual confirmation threshold: separation <= 1.5 x beam major axis (or <= 1.0 x beam major axis for full automation)

score_reason: All input FITS images and MOUS IDs are public in the ALMA Science Archive, the archive query script is provided verbatim in Appendix A, the source extraction tool (ADMIT Sfind2D_AT) and SNR threshold (3.5) are explicitly stated, and full output tables are published.
